integer_lifts.note: one lift per simplex, ordered like the sorted index tuple

encoding: T-simplices are sorted tuples of T-vertex indices.  T'-vertices are indexed by the global order (dimension, sorted tuple) over the simplices of T, so T'-vertex i < 64 is the T-vertex i.  T'-tetrahedra are the maximal chains v<e<f<t written as increasing 4-tuples of T'-vertex indices.
